<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">    expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(fixture.nativeElement.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">querySelector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'.error'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBeNull</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    vi.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">useRealTimers</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Notice that the quote element displays the placeholder value (<code>'...'</code>) on first rendering.
The first quote hasn't arrived yet.</p>
<p>Then you can assert that the quote element displays the expected text.</p>

  <h3 id="async-tests-with-zonejs-and-fakeasync">
    <a href="#async-tests-with-zonejs-and-fakeasync" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Async tests with zone.js and fakeAsync">Async tests with <code>zone.js</code> and <code>fakeAsync</code></a>
  </h3>
  <p>The <a href="/api/core/testing/fakeAsync"><code>fakeAsync</code></a> helper function is another mock clock that relies on patching asynchronous APIs with <code>zone.js</code>. It was commonly used in <code>zone.js</code> based applications for testing. The use of <a href="/api/core/testing/fakeAsync"><code>fakeAsync</code></a> is no longer recommended.</p>

      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-tip">
        <p><strong>TIP:</strong> Prefer using native async testing strategies or other fake timers (also called mock clocks) like those from Vitest or Jasmine.</p>
      </div>
      
      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-important">
        <p><strong>IMPORTANT:</strong> <a href="/api/core/testing/fakeAsync"><code>fakeAsync</code></a> requires <code>zone.js</code>. To use it with the Vitest test runner, add the <code>zone.js/plugins/vitest-patch</code> polyfill as described in <a href="guide/testing/migrating-to-vitest#zonejs-vitest-patch">the Vitest migration guide</a>.</p>
      </div>
      
  <h2 id="component-with-inputs-and-outputs">
    <a href="#component-with-inputs-and-outputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Component with inputs and outputs">Component with inputs and outputs</a>
  </h2>
  <p>A component with inputs and outputs typically appears inside the view template of a host component.
The host uses a property binding to set the input property and an event binding to listen to events raised by the output property.</p>
<p>The testing goal is to verify that such bindings work as expected.
The tests should set input values and listen for output events.</p>
<p>The <code>DashboardHero</code> component is a tiny example of a component in this role.
It displays an individual hero provided by the <code>Dashboard</code> component.
Clicking that hero tells the <code>Dashboard</code> component that the user has selected the hero.</p>
<p>The <code>DashboardHero</code> component is embedded in the <code>Dashboard</code> component template like this:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">@for</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> of</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> heroes; </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">track</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hero) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">dashboard-hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"col-1-4"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [hero]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"hero"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> (selected)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"gotoDetail($event)"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The <code>DashboardHero</code> component appears in an <code>@for</code> block, which sets each component's <code>hero</code> input property to the looping value and listens for the component's <code>selected</code> event.</p>
<p>Here's the component's full definition:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  selector: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'dashboard-hero'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  imports: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/common/UpperCasePipe">UpperCasePipe</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  template: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">`</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">button</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> type</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"button"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> (click)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"click()"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"hero"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      {{ </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">().name </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">|</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> uppercase</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> }}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">button</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">  `</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> DashboardHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  readonly</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> input.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">required</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  readonly</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> selected</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/output">output</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  click</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">    this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.selected.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">emit</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">());</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>While testing a component this simple has little intrinsic value, it's worth knowing how.
Use one of these approaches:</p>

  <ul class="docs-list">
    <li>Test it as used by the <code>Dashboard</code> component</li>
<li>Test it as a standalone component</li>
<li>Test it as used by a substitute for the <code>Dashboard</code> component</li>

  </ul>
  <p>The immediate goal is to test the <code>DashboardHero</code> component, not the <code>Dashboard</code> component, so, try the second and third options.</p>

  <h3 id="test-the-dashboardhero-component-standalone">
    <a href="#test-the-dashboardhero-component-standalone" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Test the DashboardHero component standalone">Test the <code>DashboardHero</code> component standalone</a>
  </h3>
  <p>Here's the meat of the spec file setup.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/testing/ComponentFixture">ComponentFixture</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">DashboardHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> comp</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> DashboardHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> heroDe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/DebugElement">DebugElement</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> heroEl</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HTMLElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> expectedHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  fixture </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/createComponent">createComponent</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(DashboardHero);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  comp </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.componentInstance;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // find the hero's DebugElement and element</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  heroDe </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.debugElement.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">query</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/platform-browser/By">By</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">css</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'.hero'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  heroEl </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> heroDe.nativeElement;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // mock the hero supplied by the parent component</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  expectedHero </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {id: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">42</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, name: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'Test Name'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // simulate the parent setting the input property with that hero</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  fixture.componentRef.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">setInput</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'hero'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, expectedHero);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // wait for initial data binding</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">whenStable</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Notice how the setup code assigns a test hero (<code>expectedHero</code>) to the component's <code>hero</code> property, emulating the way the <code>Dashboard</code> would set it using the property binding in its repeater.</p>
<p>The following test verifies that the hero name is propagated to the template using a binding.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should display hero name in uppercase'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> expectedPipedName</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> expectedHero.name.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toUpperCase</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(heroEl.textContent).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toContain</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(expectedPipedName);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Because the template passes the hero name through the Angular <a href="/api/common/UpperCasePipe"><code>UpperCasePipe</code></a>, the test must match the element value with the upper-cased name.</p>

  <h3 id="clicking">
    <a href="#clicking" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Clicking">Clicking</a>
  </h3>
  <p>Clicking the hero should raise a <code>selected</code> event that the host component (<code>Dashboard</code> presumably) can hear:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should raise selected event when clicked (triggerEventHandler)'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> selectedHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> |</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> undefined</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  comp.selected.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">subscribe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">((</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (selectedHero </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hero));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  heroDe.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">triggerEventHandler</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'click'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(selectedHero).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(expectedHero);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The component's <code>selected</code> property is an <a href="/api/core/OutputEmitterRef"><code>OutputEmitterRef</code></a>, whose <code>subscribe</code> method notifies subscribers synchronously.
The test subscribes to it <em>explicitly</em> just as the host component does <em>implicitly</em>.</p>
<p>If the component behaves as expected, clicking the hero's element should tell the component's <code>selected</code> property to emit the <code>hero</code> object.</p>
<p>The test detects that event through its subscription to <code>selected</code>.</p>

  <h3 id="triggereventhandler">
    <a href="#triggereventhandler" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to triggerEventHandler"><code>triggerEventHandler</code></a>
  </h3>
  <p>The <code>heroDe</code> in the previous test is a <a href="/api/core/DebugElement"><code>DebugElement</code></a> that represents the hero <code>&lt;button&gt;</code>.</p>
<p>It has Angular properties and methods that abstract interaction with the native element.
This test calls the <a href="/api/core/DebugElement#triggerEventHandler"><code>DebugElement.triggerEventHandler</code></a> with the "click" event name.
The "click" event binding responds by calling <code>DashboardHero.click()</code>.</p>
<p>The Angular <a href="/api/core/DebugElement#triggerEventHandler"><code>DebugElement.triggerEventHandler</code></a> can raise <em>any data-bound event</em> by its <em>event name</em>.
The second parameter is the event object passed to the handler.</p>
<p>The test triggered a "click" event.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">heroDe.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">triggerEventHandler</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'click'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>In this case, the test correctly assumes that the runtime event handler, the component's <code>click()</code> method, doesn't care about the event object.</p>

      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-helpful">
        <p><strong>HELPFUL:</strong> Other handlers are less forgiving.
For example, the <a href="/api/router/RouterLink"><code>RouterLink</code></a> directive expects an object with a <code>button</code> property that identifies which mouse button, if any, was pressed during the click.
The <a href="/api/router/RouterLink"><code>RouterLink</code></a> directive throws an error if the event object is missing.</p>
      </div>
      
  <h3 id="click-the-element">
    <a href="#click-the-element" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Click the element">Click the element</a>
  </h3>
  <p>The following test alternative calls the native element's own <code>click()</code> method, which is perfectly fine for <em>this component</em>.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should raise selected event when clicked (element.click)'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> selectedHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> |</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> undefined</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  comp.selected.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">subscribe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">((</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (selectedHero </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hero));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  heroEl.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">click</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(selectedHero).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(expectedHero);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h3 id="click-helper">
    <a href="#click-helper" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to click() helper"><code>click()</code> helper</a>
  </h3>
  <p>Clicking a button, an anchor, or an arbitrary HTML element is a common test task.</p>
<p>Make that consistent and straightforward by encapsulating the <em>click-triggering</em> process in a helper such as the following <code>click()</code> function:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/** Button events to pass to `DebugElement.triggerEventHandler` for RouterLink event handler */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> ButtonClickEvents</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  left: {button: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  right: {button: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">2</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/** Simulate element click. Defaults to mouse left-button click event. */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> function</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> click</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  el</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/DebugElement">DebugElement</a><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> |</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HTMLElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  eventObj</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> any</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> ButtonClickEvents.left,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> void</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  if</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (el </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">instanceof</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HTMLElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    el.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">click</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  } </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">else</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    el.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">triggerEventHandler</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'click'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, eventObj);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The first parameter is the <em>element-to-click</em>.
If you want, pass a custom event object as the second parameter.
The default is a partial <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/MouseEvent/button" target="_blank">left-button mouse event object</a> accepted by many handlers including the <a href="/api/router/RouterLink"><code>RouterLink</code></a> directive.</p>

      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-important">
        <p><strong>IMPORTANT:</strong> The <code>click()</code> helper function is <strong>not</strong> one of the Angular testing utilities.
It's a function defined in <em>this guide's sample code</em>.
All of the sample tests use it.
If you like it, add it to your own collection of helpers.</p>
      </div>
      <p>Here's the previous test, rewritten using the click helper.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should raise selected event when clicked (click helper with DebugElement)'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> selectedHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> |</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> undefined</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  comp.selected.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">subscribe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">((</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (selectedHero </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hero));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  click</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(heroDe); </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">// click helper with DebugElement</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(selectedHero).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(expectedHero);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h2 id="component-inside-a-test-host">
    <a href="#component-inside-a-test-host" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Component inside a test host">Component inside a test host</a>
  </h2>
  <p>The previous tests played the role of the host <code>Dashboard</code> component themselves.
But does the <code>DashboardHero</code> component work correctly when properly data-bound to a host component?</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  imports: [DashboardHero],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  template: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">dashboard-hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [hero]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"hero"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> (selected)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"onSelected($event)"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> TestHost</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {id: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">42</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, name: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'Test Name'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">};</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  selectedHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> |</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> undefined</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  onSelected</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">    this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.selectedHero </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hero;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The test host sets the component's <code>hero</code> input property with its test hero.
It binds the component's <code>selected</code> event with its <code>onSelected</code> handler, which records the emitted hero in its <code>selectedHero</code> property.</p>
<p>Later, the tests will be able to check <code>selectedHero</code> to verify that the <code>DashboardHero.selected</code> event emitted the expected hero.</p>
<p>The setup for the <code>test-host</code> tests is similar to the setup for the stand-alone tests:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // create TestHost instead of DashboardHero</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  fixture </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/createComponent">createComponent</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(TestHost);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  testHost </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.componentInstance;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  heroEl </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.nativeElement.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">querySelector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'.hero'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">whenStable</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>This testing module configuration shows two important differences:</p>

  <ul class="docs-list">
    <li>It <em>creates</em> the <code>TestHost</code> component instead of the <code>DashboardHero</code></li>
<li>The <code>TestHost</code> component sets the <code>DashboardHero.hero</code> with a binding</li>

  </ul>
  <p>The <a href="/api/core/createComponent"><code>createComponent</code></a> returns a <code>fixture</code> that holds an instance of <code>TestHost</code> instead of an instance of <code>DashboardHero</code>.</p>
<p>Creating the <code>TestHost</code> has the side effect of creating a <code>DashboardHero</code> because the latter appears within the template of the former.
The query for the hero element (<code>heroEl</code>) still finds it in the test DOM, albeit at greater depth in the element tree than before.</p>
<p>The tests themselves are almost identical to the stand-alone version:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should display hero name'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> expectedPipedName</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> testHost.hero.name.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toUpperCase</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(heroEl.textContent).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toContain</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(expectedPipedName);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should raise selected event when clicked'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  click</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(heroEl);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // selected hero should be the same data bound hero</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(testHost.selectedHero).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(testHost.hero);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Only the selected event test differs.
It confirms that the selected <code>DashboardHero</code> hero really does find its way up through the event binding to the host component.</p>

  <h2 id="routing-component">
    <a href="#routing-component" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Routing component">Routing component</a>
  </h2>
  <p>A <em>routing component</em> is a component that tells the <a href="/api/router/Router"><code>Router</code></a> to navigate to another component.
The <code>Dashboard</code> component is a <em>routing component</em> because the user can navigate to the <code>HeroDetail</code> component by clicking on one of the <em>hero buttons</em> on the dashboard.</p>
<p>Angular provides test helpers to reduce boilerplate and more effectively test code which depends on <a href="/api/common/http/HttpClient"><code>HttpClient</code></a>. The <a href="/api/router/provideRouter"><code>provideRouter</code></a> function can be used directly in the test module as well.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">configureTestingModule</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    providers: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">      </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/provideRouter">provideRouter</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">([{path: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'**'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, component: Dashboard}]),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">      </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/common/http/testing/provideHttpClientTesting">provideHttpClientTesting</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      HeroService,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    ],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  harness </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/testing/RouterTestingHarness">RouterTestingHarness</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">create</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  comp </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">navigateByUrl</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'/'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, Dashboard);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/common/http/testing/HttpTestingController">HttpTestingController</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">expectOne</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'api/heroes'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/testing/flush">flush</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">getTestHeroes</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">());</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The following test clicks the displayed hero and confirms that we navigate to the expected URL.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should tell navigate when hero clicked'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // get first &lt;dashboard-hero&gt; DebugElement</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> heroDe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.routeDebugElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">query</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/platform-browser/By">By</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">css</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'dashboard-hero'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  heroDe.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">triggerEventHandler</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'selected'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, comp.heroes[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">]);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // expecting to navigate to id of the component's first hero</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> id</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> comp.heroes[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">].id;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/Router">Router</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).url, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should nav to HeroDetail for first hero'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toEqual</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">    `/heroes/${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">id</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">}`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  );</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h2 id="routed-components">
    <a href="#routed-components" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Routed components">Routed components</a>
  </h2>
  <p>A <em>routed component</em> is the destination of a <a href="/api/router/Router"><code>Router</code></a> navigation.
It can be trickier to test, especially when the route to the component <em>includes parameters</em>.
The <code>HeroDetail</code> is a <em>routed component</em> that is the destination of such a route.</p>
<p>When a user clicks a <em>Dashboard</em> hero, the <code>Dashboard</code> tells the <a href="/api/router/Router"><code>Router</code></a> to navigate to <code>heroes/:id</code>.
The <code>:id</code> is a route parameter whose value is the <code>id</code> of the hero to edit.</p>
<p>The <a href="/api/router/Router"><code>Router</code></a> matches that URL to a route to the <code>HeroDetail</code>.
It creates an <a href="/api/router/ActivatedRoute"><code>ActivatedRoute</code></a> object with the routing information and injects it into a new instance of the <code>HeroDetail</code>.</p>
<p>Here are the services injected into <code>HeroDetail</code>:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">private heroDetailService </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(HeroDetailService);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">private route </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/ActivatedRoute">ActivatedRoute</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">private router </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/Router">Router</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The <code>HeroDetail</code> component needs the <code>id</code> parameter so it can fetch the corresponding hero using the <code>HeroDetailService</code>.
The component has to get the <code>id</code> from the <a href="/api/router/ActivatedRoute#paramMap"><code>ActivatedRoute.paramMap</code></a> property which is an <code>Observable</code>.</p>
<p>It can't just reference the <code>id</code> property of the <a href="/api/router/ActivatedRoute#paramMap"><code>ActivatedRoute.paramMap</code></a>.
The component has to <em>subscribe</em> to the <a href="/api/router/ActivatedRoute#paramMap"><code>ActivatedRoute.paramMap</code></a> observable and be prepared for the <code>id</code> to change during its lifetime.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">constructor</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // get hero when `id` param changes</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">  this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.route.paramMap.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">subscribe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">((</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">pmap</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">getHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(pmap.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'id'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Tests can explore how the <code>HeroDetail</code> responds to different <code>id</code> parameter values by navigating to different routes.</p>

  <h2 id="nested-component-tests">
    <a href="#nested-component-tests" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Nested component tests">Nested component tests</a>
  </h2>
  <p>Component templates often have nested components, whose templates might contain more components.</p>
<p>The component tree can be very deep and sometimes the nested components play no role in testing the component at the top of the tree.</p>
<p>The <code>App</code> component, for example, displays a navigation bar with anchors and their <a href="/api/router/RouterLink"><code>RouterLink</code></a> directives.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">app-banner</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">app-welcome</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">nav</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref">routerLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"/dashboard"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;Dashboard&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref">routerLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"/heroes"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;Heroes&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref">routerLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"/about"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;About&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">nav</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">router-outlet</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>To validate the links but not the navigation, you don't need the <a href="/api/router/Router"><code>Router</code></a> to navigate and you don't need the <code>&lt;router-outlet&gt;</code> to mark where the <a href="/api/router/Router"><code>Router</code></a> inserts <em>routed components</em>.</p>
<p>The <code>Banner</code> and <code>Welcome</code> components (indicated by <code>&lt;app-banner&gt;</code> and <code>&lt;app-welcome&gt;</code>) are also irrelevant.</p>
<p>Yet any test that creates the <code>App</code> component in the DOM also creates instances of these three components and, if you let that happen, you'll have to configure the <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed"><code>TestBed</code></a> to create them.</p>
<p>If you neglect to declare them, the Angular compiler won't recognize the <code>&lt;app-banner&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;app-welcome&gt;</code>, and <code>&lt;router-outlet&gt;</code> tags in the <code>App</code> template and will throw an error.</p>
<p>If you declare the real components, you'll also have to declare <em>their</em> nested components and provide for <em>all</em> services injected in <em>any</em> component in the tree.</p>
<p>This section describes two techniques for minimizing the setup.
Use them, alone or in combination, to stay focused on testing the primary component.</p>

  <h3 id="stubbing-unneeded-components">
    <a href="#stubbing-unneeded-components" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Stubbing unneeded components">Stubbing unneeded components</a>
  </h3>
  <p>In the first technique, you create and declare stub versions of the components and directive that play little or no role in the tests.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({selector: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'app-banner'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, template: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> BannerStub</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({selector: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'router-outlet'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, template: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> RouterOutletStub</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({selector: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'app-welcome'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, template: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> WelcomeStub</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The stub selectors match the selectors for the corresponding real components.
But their templates and classes are empty.</p>
<p>Then declare them by overriding the <code>imports</code> of your component using <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed#overrideComponent"><code>TestBed.overrideComponent</code></a>.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> comp</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> App</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/testing/ComponentFixture">ComponentFixture</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">App</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">configureTestingModule</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    providers: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/provideRouter">provideRouter</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">([]), UserAuthentication],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">overrideComponent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(App, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    set: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      imports: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/RouterLink">RouterLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, BannerStub, RouterOutletStub, WelcomeStub],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  fixture </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/createComponent">createComponent</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(App);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  comp </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.componentInstance;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-helpful">
        <p><strong>HELPFUL:</strong> The <code>set</code> key in this example replaces all the existing imports on your component, make sure to import all dependencies, not only the stubs. Alternatively you can use the <code>remove</code>/<code>add</code> keys to selectively remove and add imports.</p>
      </div>
      
  <h3 id="noerrorsschema">
    <a href="#noerrorsschema" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA"><code>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA</code></a>
  </h3>
  <p>In the second approach, add <a href="/api/core/NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA"><code>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA</code></a> to the metadata overrides of your component.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">configureTestingModule</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    providers: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/provideRouter">provideRouter</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">([]), UserAuthentication],</span></span>
