<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">overrideComponent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(App, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    set: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      imports: [], </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">// resets all imports</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      schemas: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF" href="/api/core/NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA">NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The <a href="/api/core/NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA"><code>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA</code></a> tells the Angular compiler to ignore unrecognized elements and attributes.</p>
<p>The compiler recognizes the <code>&lt;app-root&gt;</code> element and the <a href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref"><code>routerLink</code></a> attribute because you declared a corresponding <code>App</code> component and <a href="/api/router/RouterLink"><code>RouterLink</code></a> in the <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed"><code>TestBed</code></a> configuration.</p>
<p>But the compiler won't throw an error when it encounters <code>&lt;app-banner&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;app-welcome&gt;</code>, or <code>&lt;router-outlet&gt;</code>.
It simply renders them as empty tags and the browser ignores them.</p>
<p>You no longer need the stub components.</p>

  <h3 id="use-both-techniques-together">
    <a href="#use-both-techniques-together" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Use both techniques together">Use both techniques together</a>
  </h3>
  <p>These are techniques for <em>Shallow Component Testing</em>, so-named because they reduce the visual surface of the component to just those elements in the component's template that matter for tests.</p>
<p>The <a href="/api/core/NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA"><code>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA</code></a> approach is the easier of the two but don't overuse it.</p>
<p>The <a href="/api/core/NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA"><code>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA</code></a> also prevents the compiler from telling you about the missing components and attributes that you omitted inadvertently or misspelled.
You could waste hours chasing phantom bugs that the compiler would have caught in an instant.</p>
<p>The <em>stub component</em> approach has another advantage.
While the stubs in <em>this</em> example were empty, you could give them stripped-down templates and classes if your tests need to interact with them in some way.</p>
<p>In practice you will combine the two techniques in the same setup, as seen in this example.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">configureTestingModule</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    providers: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/provideRouter">provideRouter</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">([]), UserAuthentication],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">overrideComponent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(App, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    remove: {imports: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/RouterOutlet">RouterOutlet</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, Welcome]},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    set: {schemas: [</span><a style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF" href="/api/core/NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA">NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">]},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The Angular compiler creates the <code>BannerStub</code> for the <code>&lt;app-banner&gt;</code> element and applies the <a href="/api/router/RouterLink"><code>RouterLink</code></a> to the anchors with the <a href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref"><code>routerLink</code></a> attribute, but it ignores the <code>&lt;app-welcome&gt;</code> and <code>&lt;router-outlet&gt;</code> tags.</p>

  <h3 id="bydirective-and-injected-directives">
    <a href="#bydirective-and-injected-directives" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to By.directive and injected directives"><code>By.directive</code> and injected directives</a>
  </h3>
  <p>A little more setup triggers the initial data binding and gets references to the navigation links:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">whenStable</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // find DebugElements with an attached RouterLinkStubDirective</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  linkDes </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.debugElement.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">queryAll</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/platform-browser/By">By</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">directive</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/RouterLink">RouterLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // get attached link directive instances</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // using each DebugElement's injector</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  routerLinks </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> linkDes.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">map</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">((</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">de</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> de.injector.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/RouterLink">RouterLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Three points of special interest:</p>

  <ul class="docs-list">
    <li>Locate the anchor elements with an attached directive using <a href="/api/platform-browser/By#directive"><code>By.directive</code></a></li>
<li>The query returns <a href="/api/core/DebugElement"><code>DebugElement</code></a> wrappers around the matching elements</li>
<li>Each <a href="/api/core/DebugElement"><code>DebugElement</code></a> exposes a dependency injector with the specific instance of the directive attached to that element</li>

  </ul>
  <p>The <code>App</code> component links to validate are as follows:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">nav</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref">routerLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"/dashboard"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;Dashboard&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref">routerLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"/heroes"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;Heroes&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref">routerLink</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"/about"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;About&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">a</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">nav</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Here are some tests that confirm those links are wired to the <a href="/api/router/RouterLinkWithHref"><code>routerLink</code></a> directives as expected:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'can get RouterLinks from template'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(routerLinks.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">length</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should have 3 routerLinks'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">3</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(routerLinks[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">].href).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'/dashboard'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(routerLinks[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">].href).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'/heroes'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(routerLinks[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">2</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">].href).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'/about'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'can click Heroes link in template'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> heroesLinkDe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> linkDes[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">]; </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">// heroes link DebugElement</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/Router">Router</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">resetConfig</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">([{path: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'**'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, children: []}]);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  heroesLinkDe.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">triggerEventHandler</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'click'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, {button: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> fixture.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">whenStable</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/Router">Router</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).url).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'/heroes'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h2 id="use-a-page-object">
    <a href="#use-a-page-object" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Use a page object">Use a <code>page</code> object</a>
  </h2>
  <p>The <code>HeroDetail</code> component is a simple view with a title, two hero fields, and two buttons.</p>
<p>But there's plenty of template complexity even in this simple form.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">@if</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> (hero) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">div</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">h2</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">span</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;{{ hero.name </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">|</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> titlecase</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> }}&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">span</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt; Details</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">h2</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">div</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">span</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;id: &lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">span</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;{{ hero.id }}&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">div</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">div</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">label</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> for</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"name"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;name: &lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">label</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> id</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"name"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/forms/SelectMultipleControlValueAccessor">ngModel</a><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">)]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"hero.name"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> placeholder</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"name"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">div</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">button</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> type</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"button"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> (click)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"save()"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;Save&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">button</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    &lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">button</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> type</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"button"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> (click)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"cancel()"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;Cancel&lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">button</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  &lt;/</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">div</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Tests that exercise the component need …</p>

  <ul class="docs-list">
    <li>To wait until a hero arrives before elements appear in the DOM</li>
<li>A reference to the title text</li>
<li>A reference to the name input box to inspect and set it</li>
<li>References to the two buttons so they can click them</li>

  </ul>
  <p>Even a small form such as this one can produce a mess of tortured conditional setup and CSS element selection.</p>
<p>Tame the complexity with a <code>Page</code> class that handles access to component properties and encapsulates the logic that sets them.</p>
<p>Here is such a <code>Page</code> class for the <code>hero-detail.component.spec.ts</code></p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Page</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // getter properties wait to query the DOM until called.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> buttons</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">queryAll</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">HTMLButtonElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'button'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> saveBtn</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.buttons[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> cancelBtn</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.buttons[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> nameDisplay</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">query</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">HTMLElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'span'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> nameInput</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">query</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">HTMLInputElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'input'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  //// query helpers ////</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> query</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">selector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> string</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.routeNativeElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">querySelector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(selector)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> as</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> queryAll</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">selector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> string</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">[] {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.routeNativeElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">querySelectorAll</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(selector) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">as</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> any</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> as</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">[];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Now the important hooks for component manipulation and inspection are neatly organized and accessible from an instance of <code>Page</code>.</p>
<p>A <a href="/api/core/createComponent"><code>createComponent</code></a> method creates a <code>page</code> object and fills in the blanks once the <code>hero</code> arrives.</p>
<div class="docs-code">

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> hostElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HTMLElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.routeNativeElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> nameInput</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HTMLInputElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hostElement.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">querySelector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'input'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> nameDisplay</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HTMLElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hostElement.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">querySelector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'span'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // simulate user entering a new name into the input box</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  nameInput.value </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> 'quick BROWN  fOx'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Dispatch a DOM event so that Angular learns of input value change.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  nameInput.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">dispatchEvent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">new</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Event</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'input'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Wait for Angular to update the display binding through the title pipe</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.fixture.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">whenStable</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(nameDisplay.textContent).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'Quick Brown  Fox'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h2 id="override-component-providers">
    <a href="#override-component-providers" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Override component providers">Override component providers</a>
  </h2>
  <p>The <code>HeroDetail</code> provides its own <code>HeroDetailService</code>.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  /* ... */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  providers: [HeroDetailService],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HeroDetail</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> heroDetailService</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(HeroDetailService);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> route</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/ActivatedRoute">ActivatedRoute</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> router</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/Router">Router</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>It's not possible to stub the component's <code>HeroDetailService</code> in the <code>providers</code> of the <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed#configureTestingModule"><code>TestBed.configureTestingModule</code></a>.
Those are providers for the <em>testing module</em>, not the component.
They prepare the dependency injector at the <em>fixture level</em>.</p>
<p>Angular creates the component with its <em>own</em> injector, which is a <em>child</em> of the fixture injector.
It registers the component's providers (the <code>HeroDetailService</code> in this case) with the child injector.</p>
<p>A test cannot get to child injector services from the fixture injector.
And <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed#configureTestingModule"><code>TestBed.configureTestingModule</code></a> can't configure them either.</p>
<p>Angular has created new instances of the real <code>HeroDetailService</code> all along!</p>

      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-helpful">
        <p><strong>HELPFUL:</strong> These tests could fail or timeout if the <code>HeroDetailService</code> made its own XHR calls to a remote server.
There might not be a remote server to call.</p>
      </div>
      <p>Fortunately, the <code>HeroDetailService</code> delegates responsibility for remote data access to an injected <code>HeroService</code>.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Service">Service</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HeroDetailService</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> heroService</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(HeroService);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The previous test configuration replaces the real <code>HeroService</code> with a <code>TestHeroService</code> that intercepts server requests and fakes their responses.</p>
<p>What if you aren't so lucky.
What if faking the <code>HeroService</code> is hard?
What if <code>HeroDetailService</code> makes its own server requests?</p>
<p>The <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed#overrideComponent"><code>TestBed.overrideComponent</code></a> method can replace the component's <code>providers</code> with easy-to-manage <em>test doubles</em> as seen in the following setup variation:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">configureTestingModule</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    providers: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">      </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/router/provideRouter">provideRouter</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">([</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">        {path: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'heroes'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, component: HeroList},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">        {path: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'heroes/:id'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, component: HeroDetail},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      ]),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">      // HeroDetailService at this level is IRRELEVANT!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">      {provide: HeroDetailService, useValue: {}},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    ],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">overrideComponent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(HeroDetail, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">    set: {providers: [{provide: HeroDetailService, useClass: HeroDetailServiceSpy}]},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  });</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Notice that <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed#configureTestingModule"><code>TestBed.configureTestingModule</code></a> no longer provides a fake <code>HeroService</code> because it's <a href="#provide-a-spy-stub-herodetailservicespy">not needed</a>.</p>

  <h3 id="the-overridecomponent-method">
    <a href="#the-overridecomponent-method" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to The overrideComponent method">The <code>overrideComponent</code> method</a>
  </h3>
  <p>Focus on the <code>overrideComponent</code> method.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">overrideComponent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(HeroDetail, {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  set: {providers: [{provide: HeroDetailService, useClass: HeroDetailServiceSpy}]},</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>It takes two arguments: the component type to override (<code>HeroDetail</code>) and an override metadata object.
The <a href="/guide/testing/utility-apis#testbed-class-summary">override metadata object</a> is a generic defined as follows:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">type</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/testing/MetadataOverride">MetadataOverride</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt; </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  add</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">?:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Partial</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  remove</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">?:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Partial</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  set</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">?:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Partial</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">T</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">};</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>A metadata override object can either add-and-remove elements in metadata properties or completely reset those properties.
This example resets the component's <code>providers</code> metadata.</p>
<p>The type parameter, <code>T</code>, is the kind of metadata you'd pass to the <a href="/api/core/Component"><code>@Component</code></a> decorator:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">selector</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">?:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> string;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">template</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">?:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> string;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">templateUrl</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">?:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> string;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">providers</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">?:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> any[];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">…</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h3 id="provide-a-spy-stub-herodetailservicespy">
    <a href="#provide-a-spy-stub-herodetailservicespy" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Provide a spy stub (HeroDetailServiceSpy)">Provide a <em>spy stub</em> (<code>HeroDetailServiceSpy</code>)</a>
  </h3>
  <p>This example completely replaces the component's <code>providers</code> array with a new array containing a <code>HeroDetailServiceSpy</code>.</p>
<p>The <code>HeroDetailServiceSpy</code> is a stubbed version of the real <code>HeroDetailService</code> that fakes all necessary features of that service.
It neither injects nor delegates to the lower level <code>HeroService</code> so there's no need to provide a test double for that.</p>
<p>The related <code>HeroDetail</code> component tests will assert that methods of the <code>HeroDetailService</code> were called by spying on the service methods.
Accordingly, the stub implements its methods as spies:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">import</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {vi} </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">from</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> 'vitest'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HeroDetailServiceSpy</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  testHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">...</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">testHero};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  /* emit cloned test hero */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  getHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> vi.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">fn</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> asyncData</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">...</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.testHero}));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  /* emit clone of test hero, with changes merged in */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  saveHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> vi.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">fn</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">((</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Hero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> asyncData</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(Object.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">assign</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.testHero, hero)));</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h3 id="the-override-tests">
    <a href="#the-override-tests" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to The override tests">The override tests</a>
  </h3>
  <p>Now the tests can control the component's hero directly by manipulating the spy-stub's <code>testHero</code> and confirm that service methods were called.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">let</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hdsSpy</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> HeroDetailServiceSpy</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">beforeEach</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  harness </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/router/testing/RouterTestingHarness">RouterTestingHarness</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">create</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  component </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">navigateByUrl</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">`/heroes/${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">testHero</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">id</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">}`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, HeroDetail);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  page </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> new</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Page</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // get the component's injected HeroDetailServiceSpy</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  hdsSpy </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.routeDebugElement</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">!</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.injector.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(HeroDetailService) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">as</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> any</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  harness.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">detectChanges</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should have called `getHero`'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(hdsSpy.getHero, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'getHero called once'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toHaveBeenCalledTimes</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"should display stub hero's name"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(page.nameDisplay.textContent).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(hdsSpy.testHero.name);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">it</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'should save stub hero change'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">async</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> () </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> origName</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> hdsSpy.testHero.name;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  const</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> newName</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> 'New Name'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  page.nameInput.value </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> newName;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  page.nameInput.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">dispatchEvent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">new</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> Event</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'input'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)); </span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">// tell Angular</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(component.hero.name, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'component hero has new name'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(newName);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(hdsSpy.testHero.name, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'service hero unchanged before save'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(origName);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  click</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(page.saveBtn);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(hdsSpy.saveHero, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'saveHero called once'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toHaveBeenCalledTimes</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  await</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> harness.fixture.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">whenStable</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(hdsSpy.testHero.name, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'service hero has new name after save'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toBe</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(newName);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  expect</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(<a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed">TestBed</a>.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">inject</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(<a href="/api/router/Router">Router</a>).url).</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">toEqual</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'/heroes'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h3 id="more-overrides">
    <a href="#more-overrides" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to More overrides">More overrides</a>
  </h3>
  <p>The <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed#overrideComponent"><code>TestBed.overrideComponent</code></a> method can be called multiple times for the same or different components.
The <a href="/api/core/testing/TestBed"><code>TestBed</code></a> offers similar <code>overrideDirective</code>, <code>overrideModule</code>, and <code>overridePipe</code> methods for digging into and replacing parts of these other classes.</p>
<p>Explore the options and combinations on your own.</p>

does not bind data\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>For your first test you'd like to see that the screen displays the default \u003Ccode>title\u003C\u002Fcode>.\nYour instinct is to write performs \u003Cstrong>change detection\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>In production, change detection kicks in automatically when Angular creates a component or the user enters a \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>Welcome\u003C\u002Fcode> component has decision logic that interacts with the service, logic that makes this component worth testing.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"provide-service-test-doubles\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#provide-service-test-doubles\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Provide service test doubles\">Provide service test doubles\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>A \u003Cem>component-under-test\u003C\u002Fem> doesn't have to be provided with real services.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Injecting the real \u003Ccode>UserAuthentication\u003C\u002Fcode> could be difficult.\nThe real service might ask the user for login credentials and attempt to reach an authentication server.\nThese behaviors can be hard to intercept. Be aware that using test doubles makes the test behave differently from production so use them sparingly.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"get-injected-services\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#get-injected-services\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Get injected services\">Get injected services\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>The tests need access to the \u003Ccode>UserAuthentication\u003C\u002Fcode> injected into the \u003Ccode>Welcome\u003C\u002Fcode> component.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Angular has a hierarchical injection system.\nThere can be injectors at multiple levels, from the root injector created by the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed\">\u003Ccode>TestBed\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> down through the component tree.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The safest way to get the injected service, the way that \u003Cstrong>\u003Cem>always works\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fstrong>,\nis to \u003Cstrong>get it from the injector of the \u003Cem>component-under-test\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fstrong>.\nThe component injector is a property of the fixture's \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FDebugElement\">\u003Ccode>DebugElement\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D\">\u002F\u002F UserAuthentication actually injected into the component\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">userAuth \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> fixture.debugElement.injector.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">get\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(UserAuthentication);\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \u003Cdiv class=\"docs-alert docs-alert-helpful\">\n        \u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>HELPFUL:\u003C\u002Fstrong> This is \u003Cem>usually\u003C\u002Fem> not necessary. Services are often provided in the root or the TestBed overrides and can be retrieved more easily with \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed#inject\">\u003Ccode>TestBed.inject()\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> (see below).\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \n  \u003Ch3 id=\"testbedinject\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#testbedinject\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to TestBed.inject()\">\u003Ccode>TestBed.inject()\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>This is easier to remember and less verbose than retrieving a service using the fixture's \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FDebugElement\">\u003Ccode>DebugElement\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>In this test suite, the \u003Cem>only\u003C\u002Fem> provider of \u003Ccode>UserAuthentication\u003C\u002Fcode> is the root testing module, so it is safe to call \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed#inject\">\u003Ccode>TestBed.inject()\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> as follows:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">userAuth \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed\">TestBed\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">inject\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan
