docs-alert-helpful\">\n        \u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>HELPFUL:\u003C\u002Fstrong> For a use case in which \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed#inject\">\u003Ccode>TestBed.inject()\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> does not work, see the \u003Ca href=\"#override-component-providers\">\u003Cem>Override component providers\u003C\u002Fem>\u003C\u002Fa> section that explains when and why you must get the service from the component's injector instead.\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \n  \u003Ch3 id=\"final-setup-and-tests\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#final-setup-and-tests\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Final setup and tests\">Final setup and tests\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>Here's the complete \u003Ccode>beforeEach()\u003C\u002Fcode>, using \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed#inject\">\u003Ccode>TestBed.inject()\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">let\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> fixture\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan \u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>HELPFUL:\u003C\u002Fstrong> The 2nd argument of \u003Ccode>expect\u003C\u002Fcode> (for example, \u003Ccode>&#39;expected name&#39;\u003C\u002Fcode>) is an optional failure label.\nIf the expectation fails, Vitest appends this label to the expectation failure message.\nIn a spec with multiple expectations, it can help clarify what went wrong and which expectation failed.\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \u003Cp>The remaining tests confirm the logic of the component when the service returns different values.\nThe second test validates the effect of  \u003Cp>In this sample, the \u003Ccode>About\u003C\u002Fcode> component template hosts a \u003Ccode>Twain\u003C\u002Fcode> component.\nThe \u003Ccode>Twain\u003C\u002Fcode> component displays Mark class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">  );\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan gets quotes from an injected \u003Ccode>TwainQuotes\u003C\u002Fcode>.\nThe component starts the returned \u003Ccode>Observable\u003C\u002Fcode> with a placeholder value (\u003Ccode>&#39;...&#39;\u003C\u002Fcode>), before the service can return its first quote.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>catchError\u003C\u002Fcode> intercepts service errors, prepares an error message, and returns the placeholder value on the success channel.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>These are all features you'll want to test.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"testing-by-mocking-http-requests-with-the-httptestingcontroller\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#testing-by-mocking-http-requests-with-the-httptestingcontroller\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Testing by mocking http requests with the HttpTestingController.\">Testing by mocking http requests with the \u003Ccode>HttpTestingController\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>When testing a component, only the service's public API should matter.\nIn general, tests themselves should not make calls to remote servers.\nThey should emulate such calls.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>In the case your async service relies on the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcommon\u002Fhttp\u002FHttpClient\">\u003Ccode>HttpClient\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> to load remote data, it is recommended to return mock responses at the HTTP level with the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcommon\u002Fhttp\u002Ftesting\u002FHttpTestingController\">\u003Ccode>HttpTestingController\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>For more details on mocking the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcommon\u002Fhttp\u002FHttpBackend\">\u003Ccode>HttpBackend\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>, refer to the \u003Ca href=\"guide\u002Fhttp\u002Ftesting\">dedicated guide\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"testing-by-providing-a-stubbed-implementation-of-a-service\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#testing-by-providing-a-stubbed-implementation-of-a-service\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Testing by providing a stubbed implementation of a service.\">Testing by providing a stubbed implementation of a service.\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>When mocking async request at the http level isn't possible, an alternative is to leverage spies.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The setup in this \u003Ccode>app\u002Ftwain\u002Ftwain-quotes.spec.ts\u003C\u002Fcode> shows one way to do that:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\" header=\"twain.spec.ts\">\n    \u003Cdiv the original one.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">configureTestingModule\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan component or service that injects it will receive the stubbed implementation.\nIt means that any call to \u003Ccode>getQuote\u003C\u002Fcode> receives an observable with a test quote.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Unlike the real \u003Ccode>getQuote()\u003C\u002Fcode> method, this spy bypasses the server and returns a synchronous observable whose value is available placeholder value (\u003Ccode>&#39;...&#39;\u003C\u002Fcode>) on first rendering.\nThe first quote hasn't arrived yet.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Then you can assert that the quote element displays the expected text.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"async-tests-with-zonejs-and-fakeasync\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#async-tests-with-zonejs-and-fakeasync\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Async tests with zone.js and fakeAsync\">Async tests with \u003Ccode>zone.js\u003C\u002Fcode> and \u003Ccode>fakeAsync\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>The \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FfakeAsync\">\u003Ccode>fakeAsync\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> helper function is another mock clock that relies on patching asynchronous APIs with \u003Ccode>zone.js\u003C\u002Fcode>. It was commonly used in \u003Ccode>zone.js\u003C\u002Fcode> based applications for testing. The use of \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FfakeAsync\">\u003Ccode>fakeAsync\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> is no longer recommended.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n      \u003Cdiv class=\"docs-alert docs-alert-tip\">\n        \u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>TIP:\u003C\u002Fstrong> Prefer using native async testing strategies or other fake timers (also called mock clocks) like those from Vitest or Jasmine.\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \n      \u003Cdiv class=\"docs-alert docs-alert-important\">\n        \u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>IMPORTANT:\u003C\u002Fstrong> \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FfakeAsync\">\u003Ccode>fakeAsync\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> requires \u003Ccode>zone.js\u003C\u002Fcode>. To use it with the Vitest test runner, add the \u003Ccode>zone.js\u002Fplugins\u002Fvitest-patch\u003C\u002Fcode> polyfill as described in \u003Ca href=\"guide\u002Ftesting\u002Fmigrating-to-vitest#zonejs-vitest-patch\">the Vitest migration guide\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \n  \u003Ch2 id=\"component-with-inputs-and-outputs\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#component-with-inputs-and-outputs\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Component with inputs and outputs\">Component with inputs and outputs\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh2>\n  \u003Cp>A component with inputs and outputs typically appears inside the view template of a host component.\nThe host uses a property binding to set the input property and an event binding to listen to events raised by the output property.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The testing goal is to verify that such bindings work as expected.\nThe tests should set input values and listen for output events.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>DashboardHero\u003C\u002Fcode> component is a tiny example of a component in this role.\nIt displays an individual hero provided by the \u003Ccode>Dashboard\u003C\u002Fcode> component.\nClicking that hero tells the \u003Ccode>Dashboard\u003C\u002Fcode> component that the user has selected the hero.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>DashboardHero\u003C\u002Fcode> component is embedded in the \u003Ccode>Dashboard\u003C\u002Fcode> component template like this:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">@for\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> (\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF\">hero\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\"> of\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> heroes; \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">track\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> hero) {\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">  &lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">dashboard-hero\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> class\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">\"col-1-4\"\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> [hero]\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">\"hero\"\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> (selected)\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">\"gotoDetail($event)\"\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> \u002F&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>DashboardHero\u003C\u002Fcode> component appears in an \u003Ccode>@for\u003C\u002Fcode> block, which sets each component's \u003Ccode>hero\u003C\u002Fcode> input property to the looping value and listens for the component's \u003Ccode>selected\u003C\u002Fcode> event.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Here's the component's full definition:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">@\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" \u003Ccode>subscribe\u003C\u002Fcode> method notifies subscribers synchronously.\nThe test subscribes to it \u003Cem>explicitly\u003C\u002Fem> just as the host component does \u003Cem>implicitly\u003C\u002Fem>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>If the component behaves as expected, clicking the hero's element should tell the component's \u003Ccode>selected\u003C\u002Fcode> property to emit the \u003Ccode>hero\u003C\u002Fcode> object.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The test detects that event through its subscription to \u003Ccode>selected\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 its \u003Cem>event name\u003C\u002Fem>.\nThe second parameter is the event object passed to the handler.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The test triggered a \"click\" event.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" \u003Cem>element-to-click\u003C\u002Fem>.\nIf you want, pass a custom event object as the second parameter.\nThe default is a partial \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdeveloper.mozilla.org\u002Fdocs\u002FWeb\u002FAPI\u002FMouseEvent\u002Fbutton\" target=\"_blank\">left-button mouse event object\u003C\u002Fa> accepted by many handlers including the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouterLink\">\u003Ccode>RouterLink\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> directive.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n      \u003Cdiv class=\"docs-alert testing utilities.\nIt's a function defined in \u003Cem>this guide's sample code\u003C\u002Fem>.\nAll of the sample tests use it.\nIf you like it, add it to your own collection of helpers.\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \u003Cp>Here's the previous test, rewritten using the click helper.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre component's \u003Ccode>hero\u003C\u002Fcode> input property with its test hero.\nIt binds the component's \u003Ccode>selected\u003C\u002Fcode> event with its \u003Ccode>onSelected\u003C\u002Fcode> handler, which records the emitted hero in its \u003Ccode>selectedHero\u003C\u002Fcode> property.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Later, the tests will be able to check \u003Ccode>selectedHero\u003C\u002Fcode> to verify that the \u003Ccode>DashboardHero.selected\u003C\u002Fcode> event emitted the expected hero.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The setup for the \u003Ccode>test-host\u003C\u002Fcode> tests is similar to the setup for the stand-alone tests:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">});\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>This testing module configuration shows two important differences:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Cul class=\"docs-list\">\n    \u003Cli>It \u003Cem>creates\u003C\u002Fem> the \u003Ccode>TestHost\u003C\u002Fcode> component instead of the \u003Ccode>DashboardHero\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fli>\n\u003Cli>The \u003Ccode>TestHost\u003C\u002Fcode> component sets the \u003Ccode>DashboardHero.hero\u003C\u002Fcode> with a binding\u003C\u002Fli>\n\n  \u003C\u002Ful>\n  \u003Cp>The \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FcreateComponent\">\u003Ccode>createComponent\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> returns a \u003Ccode>fixture\u003C\u002Fcode> that holds an instance of \u003Ccode>TestHost\u003C\u002Fcode> instead of an instance of \u003Ccode>DashboardHero\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Creating the \u003Ccode>TestHost\u003C\u002Fcode> has the side effect of creating a \u003Ccode>DashboardHero\u003C\u002Fcode> because the latter appears within the template of the former.\nThe query for the hero element (\u003Ccode>heroEl\u003C\u002Fcode>) still finds it in the test DOM, albeit at greater depth in the element tree than before.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The tests themselves are almost identical to the stand-alone version:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" when the route to the component \u003Cem>includes parameters\u003C\u002Fem>.\nThe \u003Ccode>HeroDetail\u003C\u002Fcode> is a \u003Cem>routed component\u003C\u002Fem> that is the destination of such a route.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>When a user clicks a \u003Cem>Dashboard\u003C\u002Fem> hero, the \u003Ccode>Dashboard\u003C\u002Fcode> tells the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouter\">\u003Ccode>Router\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> to navigate to \u003Ccode>heroes\u002F:id\u003C\u002Fcode>.\nThe \u003Ccode>:id\u003C\u002Fcode> is a route parameter whose value is the \u003Ccode>id\u003C\u002Fcode> of the hero to edit.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouter\">\u003Ccode>Router\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> matches that URL to a route to the \u003Ccode>HeroDetail\u003C\u002Fcode>.\nIt creates an \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FActivatedRoute\">\u003Ccode>ActivatedRoute\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> object with the routing information and injects it into a new instance of the \u003Ccode>HeroDetail\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Here are the services injected into \u003Ccode>HeroDetail\u003C\u002Fcode>:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">private heroDetailService \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> inject\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(HeroDetailService);\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">private route \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> inject\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FActivatedRoute\">ActivatedRoute\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">);\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">private router \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> inject\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouter\">Router\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">);\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>HeroDetail\u003C\u002Fcode> component needs the \u003Ccode>id\u003C\u002Fcode> parameter so it can fetch the corresponding hero using the \u003Ccode>HeroDetailService\u003C\u002Fcode>.\nThe component has to get the \u003Ccode>id\u003C\u002Fcode> from the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FActivatedRoute#paramMap\">\u003Ccode>ActivatedRoute.paramMap\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> property which is an \u003Ccode>Observable\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>It can't just reference the \u003Ccode>id\u003C\u002Fcode> property of the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FActivatedRoute#paramMap\">\u003Ccode>ActivatedRoute.paramMap\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>.\nThe component has to \u003Cem>subscribe\u003C\u002Fem> to the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FActivatedRoute#paramMap\">\u003Ccode>ActivatedRoute.paramMap\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> observable and be prepared for the \u003Ccode>id\u003C\u002Fcode> to change during its lifetime.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">constructor\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">() {\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D\">  \u002F\u002F get hero when `id` param changes\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF\">  this\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">.route.paramMap.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">subscribe\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">((\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70\">pmap\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">) \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">=&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF\"> this\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">getHero\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(pmap.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">get\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">'id'\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">)));\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>Tests can explore how the \u003Ccode>HeroDetail\u003C\u002Fcode> responds to different \u003Ccode>id\u003C\u002Fcode> parameter values by navigating to different routes.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch2 id=\"nested-component-tests\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#nested-component-tests\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Nested component tests\">Nested component tests\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh2>\n  \u003Cp>Component templates often have nested components, whose templates might contain more components.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The component tree can be very deep and sometimes the nested components play no role in testing the component at the top of the tree.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>App\u003C\u002Fcode> component, for example, displays a navigation bar with anchors and their \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouterLink\">\u003Ccode>RouterLink\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> directives.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">app-banner\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> \u002F&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">app-welcome\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> \u002F&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">nav\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">  &lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">a\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouterLinkWithHref\">routerLink\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">\"\u002Fdashboard\"\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;Dashboard&lt;\u002F\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">a\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">  &lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">a\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouterLinkWithHref\">routerLink\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">\"\u002Fheroes\"\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;Heroes&lt;\u002F\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">a\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">  &lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">a\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouterLinkWithHref\">routerLink\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">=\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">\"\u002Fabout\"\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;About&lt;\u002F\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">a\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&lt;\u002F\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">nav\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D\">router-outlet\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> \u002F&gt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>To validate the links but not the navigation, you don't need the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouter\">\u003Ccode>Router\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> to navigate and you don't need the \u003Ccode>&lt;router-outlet&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode> to mark where the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouter\">\u003Ccode>Router\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> inserts \u003Cem>routed components\u003C\u002Fem>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>Banner\u003C\u002Fcode> and \u003Ccode>Welcome\u003C\u002Fcode> components (indicated by \u003Ccode>&lt;app-banner&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode> and \u003Ccode>&lt;app-welcome&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode>) are also irrelevant.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Yet any test that creates the \u003Ccode>App\u003C\u002Fcode> component in the DOM also creates instances of these three components and, if you let that happen, you'll have to configure the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed\">\u003Ccode>TestBed\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> to create them.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>If you neglect to declare them, the Angular compiler won't recognize the \u003Ccode>&lt;app-banner&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode>, \u003Ccode>&lt;app-welcome&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode>, and \u003Ccode>&lt;router-outlet&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode> tags in the \u003Ccode>App\u003C\u002Fcode> template and will throw an error.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>If you declare the real components, you'll also have to declare \u003Cem>their\u003C\u002Fem> nested components and provide for \u003Cem>all\u003C\u002Fem> services injected in \u003Cem>any\u003C\u002Fem> component in the tree.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>This section describes two techniques for minimizing the setup.\nUse them, alone or in combination, to stay focused on testing the primary component.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"stubbing-unneeded-components\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#stubbing-unneeded-components\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Stubbing unneeded components\">Stubbing unneeded components\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>In the first technique, you create and declare stub versions of the components and directive that play little or no role in the tests.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">@\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">class\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> BannerStub\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> {}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">@\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FComponent\">Component\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">({selector: \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">'router-outlet'\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">, template: \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">''\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">})\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">class\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> RouterOutletStub\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> {}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">@\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FComponent\">Component\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">({selector: \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">'app-welcome'\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">, template: \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">''\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">})\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\">class\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\"> WelcomeStub\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> {}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>The stub selectors match the selectors for the corresponding real components.\nBut their templates and classes are empty.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Then declare them by overriding the \u003Ccode>imports\u003C\u002Fcode> of your component using \u003Ca to import all dependencies, not only the stubs. Alternatively you can use the \u003Ccode>remove\u003C\u002Fcode>\u002F\u003Ccode>add\u003C\u002Fcode> keys to selectively remove and add imports.\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \n  \u003Ch3 id=\"noerrorsschema\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#noerrorsschema\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FNO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\">\u003Ccode>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> to the metadata overrides of your component.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FNO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\">\u003Ccode>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> tells the Angular compiler to ignore unrecognized elements and attributes.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The compiler recognizes the \u003Ccode>&lt;app-root&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode> element and the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouterLinkWithHref\">\u003Ccode>routerLink\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> attribute because you declared a corresponding \u003Ccode>App\u003C\u002Fcode> component and \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Frouter\u002FRouterLink\">\u003Ccode>RouterLink\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> in the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed\">\u003Ccode>TestBed\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> configuration.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>But the compiler won't throw an error when it encounters \u003Ccode>&lt;app-banner&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode>, \u003Ccode>&lt;app-welcome&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode>, or \u003Ccode>&lt;router-outlet&gt;\u003C\u002Fcode>.\nIt simply renders them as empty tags and the browser ignores them.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>You no longer need the stub components.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"use-both-techniques-together\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#use-both-techniques-together\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Use both techniques together\">Use both techniques together\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>These are techniques for \u003Cem>Shallow Component Testing\u003C\u002Fem>, so-named because they reduce the visual surface of the component to just those elements in the component's template that matter for tests.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FNO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\">\u003Ccode>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> approach is the easier of the two but don't overuse it.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FNO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\">\u003Ccode>NO_ERRORS_SCHEMA\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> also prevents the compiler from telling you about the missing components and attributes that you omitted inadvertently or misspelled.\nYou could waste hours chasing phantom bugs that the compiler would have caught in an instant.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The \u003Cem>stub component\u003C\u002Fem> approach has another advantage.\nWhile the stubs in \u003Cem>this\u003C\u002Fem> example were empty, you could give them stripped-down templates and classes if your tests need to interact with them in some way.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>In practice you will combine the two techniques in the same setup, as seen in this example.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" the component's \u003Ccode>HeroDetailService\u003C\u002Fcode> in the \u003Ccode>providers\u003C\u002Fcode> of the \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed#configureTestingModule\">\u003Ccode>TestBed.configureTestingModule\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>.\nThose are providers for the \u003Cem>testing module\u003C\u002Fem>, not the component.\nThey prepare the dependency injector at the \u003Cem>fixture level\u003C\u002Fem>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Angular creates the component with its \u003Cem>own\u003C\u002Fem> injector, which is a \u003Cem>child\u003C\u002Fem> of the fixture injector.\nIt registers the component's providers (the \u003Ccode>HeroDetailService\u003C\u002Fcode> in this case) with the child injector.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>A test cannot get to child injector services from the fixture injector.\nAnd \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Ftesting\u002FTestBed#configureTestingModule\">\u003Ccode>TestBed.configureTestingModule\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> can't configure them either.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Angular has created new instances of the real \u003Ccode>HeroDetailService\u003C\u002Fcode> all along!\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n      \u003Cdiv class=\"docs-alert docs-alert-helpful\">\n        \u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>HELPFUL:\u003C\u002Fstrong> These tests could fail or timeout if the \u003Ccode>HeroDetailService\u003C\u002Fcode> made its own XHR calls to a remote server.\nThere might not be a remote server to call.\u003C\u002Fp>\n      \u003C\u002Fdiv>\n      \u003Cp>Fortunately, the \u003Ccode>HeroDetailService\u003C\u002Fcode> delegates responsibility for remote data access to an injected \u003Ccode>HeroService\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\"
